_readme: Full Tamil Nadu jurisdiction dataset: 38 districts, 388 blocks, 148 municipalities + 25 municipal corporations, 493 town panchayats (one duplicate entry in the source removed) (administrative tree); 39 Parliament Constituencies and 234 Assembly Constituencies (electoral tree). Sourced from Wikipedia's district-verified developmental-administrative-units, urban-local-bodies, nagar-panchayats, municipal-corporations, and Tamil-Nadu-Legislative-Assembly-constituencies articles (raw wikitext parsed directly, not AI-summarized, and cross-checked against each source's own stated totals) — still not the authoritative ECI/TN government dataset, and boundaries/names drift over time with local-body reorganizations; treat this as a strong, real starting point to replace with an official bulk import when one is available, per spec.md's Assumptions. Entries list a parent before any of its children — seed.ts imports them in file order. Village-level data added from India Data Portal's LGD (Ministry of Panchayati Raj) mirror (villages-lgd-codes.csv, TN slice, data last updated 2023-10-20, ODC-BY licensed) -- 16849 villages placed under 388 blocks (373 auto-matched by fuzzy name within district + 8 manually-verified transliteration matches + 7 new blocks LGD has that the Wikipedia block list was missing: St. Thomas Mount, K.V.Kuppam, West Arani, Macdonalds Choultry, Mallasamudram, Watrap, R.K.Pet). 1861 villages were dropped because LGD left their block_code blank and their taluk (sub_district) maps to more than one real block, making automatic placement unsafe -- a documented gap, not a silent guess. 138 villages share a name with another real, distinct village in the same block -- suffixed with their LGD village_code in parens so seed.ts's name-based idempotency match doesn't silently collapse them into one row.
